title: Ankhorage Expo Localization Orchestrator Module
summary: Provides an Orchestrator module, host bindings, and administration UI for Expo localization resources and configuration.
purpose: Manage Expo localization as a deterministic project module while keeping runtime and authoring integrations explicit.
responsibilities: Define localization module configuration, resources, templates, and lifecycle behavior.
Expose host and capability bindings for localization runtime integration.
Provide administration operations and UI for dictionaries, locales, missing translations, and translatable fields.
boundaries: Does not own the Orchestrator lifecycle engine or Expo runtime.
Does not define application-specific translation content.
Does not make ZORA a hard runtime dependency outside the optional administration view.
audience: Expo projects installing localization through Ankhorage Orchestrator.
Authoring tools that manage localization resources and dictionaries.
useCases: Install localization configuration and resource templates into an Expo project.
Bind project localization through the module host entrypoint.
Manage locales and translation dictionaries through the administration view.

architecture.role: Provider module adapting Expo localization concerns to Orchestrator lifecycle and host boundaries.
invariants: Project changes are expressed through the published Orchestrator module contract.
Runtime integration uses the published Expo Runtime boundary.
Administration UI remains an explicit optional subpath.

limitations: Administration UI requires compatible React and ZORA peers.
Localization behavior is limited to resources and operations defined by the module.
